title: ISO 8601 dates
description:
Validate dates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` form, following the standard's rules.

```
2026-11-20 -> valid (Friday)
2024-02-29 -> valid (leap year)
2023-02-29 -> invalid: February 2023 has 28 days
2026-13-01 -> invalid: month 13
20261120   -> valid basic format
```
hints: `std::chrono::year_month_day{std::chrono::year{y}, std::chrono::month{m}, std::chrono::day{d}}.ok()` checks it for you, as a second opinion (lesson 4.04).
`std::chrono::weekday{std::chrono::sys_days{ymd}}` gives the day of the week.
requirements: Accept the extended form (`2026-11-20`) and the basic form (`20261120`).
Check month ranges and days per month, with the Gregorian leap year rule.
